name: Aug-NeRF
definition: A training framework that injects worst-case perturbations into three distinct levels of the NeRF pipeline (input coordinates, intermediate features, pre-rendering output) to implicitly regularize the model with physical grounds, addressing inconsistent and non-smooth geometries.
summary: Aug-NeRF is a NeRF training framework that injects worst-case adversarial perturbations into coordinates, features, and outputs to implicitly regularize the model with physical grounds.
